questions.question: The area of a triangle is constant. Find the percentage increase in its perpendicular height if the base of the triangle is decreased by 20%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the product of two variables is constant, and one variable decreases by x%, the other must increase by [x / (100 − x)] × 100%.

Here, the base decreases by 20%, so x = 20.

Percentage increase in height = [20 / (100 − 20)] × 100%

⇒ (20 / 80) × 100% = (1 / 4) × 100% = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The area of the triangle is constant.

The base is decreased by 20%.

**Formula Used:**

Area of a triangle = 1/2 × base × height

 Constant Area: Base × Height = Constant
 
 Base: 100
 

 

 −20%
 
 New Base: 80
 
 Height: 80
 

 

 +25%
 
 New Height: 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the initial base be b and the initial height be h.

⇒ Initial Area = 1/2 × b × h

⇒ New base = b − 20% of b = 0.8b

⇒ Let the new height be H.

⇒ New Area = 1/2 × 0.8b × H

⇒ Since the area remains constant: 1/2 × b × h = 1/2 × 0.8b × H

⇒ b × h = 0.8b × H

⇒ H = h / 0.8 = 10/8 × h = 1.25h

⇒ Increase in height = 1.25h − h = 0.25h

⇒ Percentage increase = (0.25h / h) × 100% = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Product Rule

If A × B = Constant, a decrease of a/b in quantity A requires an increase of a/(b−a) in quantity B. Here, 20% = 1/5 decrease in base, which directly requires a 1/(5−1) = 1/4 = 25% increase in height.

Successive Percentage Change

When two variables change by a% and b%, the net percentage change in their product is given by: Net Change = a + b + (a × b) / 100. For the area to remain constant, the net change must be 0%.

Area of a Triangle

The foundational formula for the area of any triangle is 1/2 × Base × Perpendicular Height. Altering the base and height in strictly inverse proportions will always keep the overall area completely unchanged.
</p

questions.question: Parth, Rizwan and Sangeeta can do a piece of work in 40, 60 and 80 days, respectively. In how many days can Parth do the work if he is assisted by Rizwan and Sangeeta on every third day?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(40, 60, 80) = 240 units.

Efficiency: Parth = 6, Rizwan = 4, Sangeeta = 3.

Work in 1 cycle (3 days) = 6 + 6 + (6 + 4 + 3) = 25 units.

Work in 9 cycles (27 days) = 9 × 25 = 225 units. Remaining 15 units is done sequentially.

Parth does 12 units in the next 2 days (29 days total). The remaining 3 units are done by all three in 3/13 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 29 ³/₁₃ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Parth can complete the work in 40 days.

Rizwan can complete the work in 60 days.

Sangeeta can complete the work in 80 days.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 Parth
 40
 240
 6
 
 

 Rizwan
 60
 4
 
 

 Sangeeta
 80
 3
 
 

⇒ Work done by Parth on day 1 = 6 units

⇒ Work done by Parth on day 2 = 6 units

⇒ Work done by Parth, Rizwan and Sangeeta on day 3 = 6 + 4 + 3 = 13 units

⇒ Total work done in a 3-day cycle = 6 + 6 + 13 = 25 units

⇒ Work done in 9 such cycles (27 days) = 9 × 25 = 225 units

⇒ Remaining work = 240 − 225 = 15 units

⇒ On the 28th and 29th days, Parth works alone and completes 6 + 6 = 12 units

⇒ Remaining work after 29 days = 15 − 12 = 3 units

⇒ On the 30th day, all three work together (efficiency = 13). Time taken = 3 ÷ 13 days

⇒ Total time taken = 29 + 3/13 = 29 ³/₁₃ days

**∴ The correct answer is 29 ³/₁₃ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alternate Day Work Concept

When individuals work in a repeated pattern, first determine the work done in one complete cycle. Multiply by the largest integer to stay within total work, then assign remaining work sequentially day by day.

LCM Method for Total Work

Taking the Total Work as the Lowest Common Multiple (LCM) of the given days ensures that the efficiency of each person is a whole number, heavily simplifying arithmetic calculations.

Work and Wages

Wages are strictly distributed in proportion to the total work done by individuals. If all persons work for an equal number of days, their wages are distributed directly in the ratio of their daily efficiencies.
</p

questions.question: The simple interest on a principal amount (in ₹) is ₹168 for a period of 8 years at the rate of 4% per annum. The principal amount (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Simple Interest percentage = Rate × Time = 4% × 8 = 32%

This means 32% of the Principal = ₹168

⇒ 1% of Principal = 168 ÷ 32 = ₹5.25

⇒ 100% of Principal = 5.25 × 100 = ₹525

**∴ The correct answer is ₹525.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 Principal
 P = ?
 
 
 
• 
 

 
 
 Rate = 4% p.a.
 Time = 8 years
 Total Int. = 32%
 
 
 
 Simple Interest
 SI = ₹168

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹168

Rate (R) = 4% per annum

Time (T) = 8 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Where P is the Principal amount.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 168 = (P × 4 × 8) ÷ 100

⇒ 168 = 32P ÷ 100

⇒ P = (168 × 100) ÷ 32

⇒ P = 16800 ÷ 32

⇒ P = 525

**∴ The correct answer is ₹525.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest (CI)

Compound Interest is calculated on the principal and the interest accumulated over previous periods. Formula: A = P(1 + R ÷ 100)T and CI = A − P.

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years

For a given principal P and rate R% per annum, the difference between CI and SI for 2 years is calculated as: Difference = P(R ÷ 100)².

Amount in Simple Interest

The total amount (A) after a certain period is the sum of Principal and Simple Interest. Formula: A = P + SI = P(1 + R × T ÷ 100).

questions.question: Two trains having lengths of 110 m and 390 m are running at speeds of 120 km/h and 130 km/h, respectively, in the same direction. The time taken (in minutes) by the faster train, coming from behind, to completely cross the other train is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance to cross = 110 m + 390 m = 500 m = 0.5 km

Relative speed (same direction) = 130 km/h − 120 km/h = 10 km/h

Time (in hours) = Distance ÷ Speed = 0.5 km ÷ 10 km/h = 0.05 hours

Time (in minutes) = 0.05 × 60 = 3 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 3 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
•

 130 km/h →
 
 
 110 m
 120 km/h →
 
 

 Total Distance = 390 + 110 = 500 m
 
 Relative Speed = 130 − 120 = 10 km/h

**Given:**

Length of faster train (L₁) = 390 m

Length of slower train (L₂) = 110 m

Speed of faster train (S₁) = 130 km/h

Speed of slower train (S₂) = 120 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (same direction) = S₁ − S₂

Time Taken = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = L₁ + L₂ = 390 m + 110 m = 500 m

⇒ Relative Speed = 130 km/h − 120 km/h = 10 km/h

⇒ Convert Relative Speed to m/s: 10 × (5 ÷ 18) = 25 ÷ 9 m/s

⇒ Time Taken = 500 ÷ (25 ÷ 9) seconds

⇒ Time Taken = 500 × 9 ÷ 25 = 180 seconds

⇒ Convert seconds to minutes: 180 ÷ 60 = 3 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 3 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Opposite Direction

When two bodies move in opposite directions, their relative speeds are added. Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.

Crossing a Stationary Object

When a train crosses a vertical stationary object like a pole or a standing man, the distance covered is exactly equal to the length of the train itself.

Speed Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5 ÷ 18. Conversely, to convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

questions.question: The marked price of a wrist watch is ₹1,200. It is sold at two successive discounts of 5% and 8%, respectively. Find its selling price.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective discount % for successive discounts of a% and b% = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100

Net discount = 5 + 8 − (5 × 8) ÷ 100 = 13 − 0.40 = 12.6%

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price × (100 − Effective Discount)%

SP = 1200 × (100 − 12.6)% = 1200 × 87.4% = 1048.80

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1048.80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹1,200

First discount (D₁) = 5%

Second discount (D₂) = 8%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − D₁ ÷ 100) × (1 − D₂ ÷ 100)

questions.question: A man sold an article for ₹221, there by gaining 10.5%. The cost of the article (in ₹) was:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Fractional equivalent of 10.5% = 10.5 ÷ 100 = 21/200.

Let Cost Price (CP) be 200 units, then Profit = 21 units.

Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit = 200 + 21 = 221 units.

Given SP is ₹221, meaning 221 units = ₹221 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹1.

Therefore, CP = 200 units = ₹200.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹221

Profit = 10.5%

 
 CP = ?
 
 
 SP = ₹221
 
 

 

 
 + 10.5% Profit

**Formula Used:**

CP = (SP × 100) ÷ (100 + Profit%)

**Calculations:**

⇒ CP = (221 × 100) ÷ (100 + 10.5)

⇒ CP = 22100 ÷ 110.5

⇒ CP = 221000 ÷ 1105

⇒ CP = 200

**∴ The correct answer is ₹200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Loss Percentage

When an article is sold at a loss, the Selling Price is less than Cost Price. Formula: CP = (SP × 100) ÷ (100 − Loss%).

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on Marked Price (MP). SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100.

Successive Profit/Loss

If an article goes through successive percentage changes of a% and b%, the net effective change is given by: a + b + (a × b) ÷ 100.

questions.question: The value of 22 - 2 × [ 7 + 8 × { 14 - 7 ( 6 - 5 ) × 2} ÷ 37] is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

22 - 2 × [ 7 + 8 × { 14 - 7 ( 6 - 5 ) × 2} ÷ 37]

**Formula Used:**

Parentheses first, followed by brackets.

Order of operations (BODMAS): Brackets, Orders (exponents), Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 22 - 2 × [ 7 + 8 × { 14 - 7 × ( 6 - 5 ) × 2 } ÷ 37]

⇒ 22 - 2 × [ 7 + 8 × { 14 - 7 × 1 × 2 } ÷ 37]

⇒ 22 - 2 × [ 7 + 8 × { 14 - 14 } ÷ 37]

⇒ 22 - 2 × [ 7 + 8 × 0 ÷ 37]

⇒ 22 - 2 × [ 7 + 0 ]

⇒ 22 - 2 × 7

⇒ 22 - 14

⇒ 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

questions.question: A person drives 60 km at a speed of 30 km/hr, then 30 km at 60 km/hr, and finally 45 km at 90 km/hr. What is the average speed (in km/hr) for the entire trip?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Distance = 60 + 30 + 45 = 135 km

Total Time = (60 ÷ 30) + (30 ÷ 60) + (45 ÷ 90) = 2 + 0.5 + 0.5 = 3 hours

Average Speed = 135 ÷ 3 = 45 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 45 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Part 1: Distance (D₁) = 60 km, Speed (S₁) = 30 km/hr

Part 2: Distance (D₂) = 30 km, Speed (S₂) = 60 km/hr

Part 3: Distance (D₃) = 45 km, Speed (S₃) = 90 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 D₁ = 60 km
 D₂ = 30 km
 D₃ = 45 km
 
 S₁ = 30 km/hr
 S₂ = 60 km/hr
 S₃ = 90 km/hr
 
 T₁ = 2 hr
 T₂ = 0.5 hr
 T₃ = 0.5 hr
 
 Total Distance = 135 km, Total Time = 3 hr

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 60 + 30 + 45 = 135 km

⇒ Time for Part 1 (T₁) = 60 ÷ 30 = 2 hours

⇒ Time for Part 2 (T₂) = 30 ÷ 60 = 0.5 hours

⇒ Time for Part 3 (T₃) = 45 ÷ 90 = 0.5 hours

⇒ Total Time = 2 + 0.5 + 0.5 = 3 hours

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 135 ÷ 3 = 45 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 45 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

It is defined as the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken. The formula is Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed is the difference of their speeds (S₁ − S₂). When moving in opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Equal Distance Average Speed Rule

If two equal distances are covered at speeds a and b, the average speed for the entire journey is given by (2 × a × b) ÷ (a + b).
</p

questions.question: The population of a district is 383000, out of which 221000 are males. 58% of the population is literate. If 58% males are literate, then what percentage of females are literate?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the properties of weighted averages, if a population is divided into two mutually exclusive groups (males and females),

And if the overall literacy percentage matches the literacy percentage of one group (males = 58%),

Then the literacy percentage of the other group (females) must also be exactly the same.

No calculation is required since the literacy rate remains perfectly uniform across the total and its parts.

**∴ The correct answer is 58%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total population = 383000

Number of males = 221000

Overall literacy rate = 58%

Male literacy rate = 58%

**Formula Used:**

Female Literacy % = (Total Literate Females ÷ Total Females) × 100

 
 Male (58%)
 Pop: 221,000
 
 
 Female (x%)
 Pop: 162,000
 
 
 Overall
 58%
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 Ratio = |x − 58|
 
 
 Ratio = 58 − 58 = 0
 
 Since population > 0, |x − 58| must be 0 → x = 58%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Number of females = Total population − Number of males

⇒ Number of females = 383000 − 221000 = 162000

⇒ Total literate population = 58% of 383000

⇒ Total literates = (58 ÷ 100) × 383000 = 222140

⇒ Literate males = 58% of 221000

⇒ Literate males = (58 ÷ 100) × 221000 = 128180

⇒ Literate females = Total literates − Literate males

⇒ Literate females = 222140 − 128180 = 93960

⇒ Female literacy % = (93960 ÷ 162000) × 100

⇒ Female literacy % = 0.58 × 100 = 58%

**∴ The correct answer is 58%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Uniformity

When two groups combine to form a whole, if one group shares the exact same average or percentage as the entire combined group, the second group must inherently possess that identical average as well.

Alligation Method

Alligation is a standard technique used to find the ratio in which two quantities are mixed. The ratio is determined by cross-subtracting the individual values from the mean: Ratio = |V₂ − Mean| : |V₁ − Mean|.

Percentage Base Dependency

A percentage inherently represents a fraction of a base value. In population-based literacy questions, if the rate (%) remains universally constant, the absolute count of literates simply scales linearly with the respective population breakdowns.
</p

questions.question: Let x be the greatest number which, when divided by 31, 61 and 91, leaves the same remainder. The LCM of x and 48 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The greatest number leaving the same remainder is the HCF of the differences of the given numbers.

Differences: (61 − 31) = 30, (91 − 61) = 30, (91 − 31) = 60.

x = HCF(30, 30, 60) = 30.

Required LCM = LCM(30, 48).

Since 30 = 6 × 5 and 48 = 6 × 8, LCM = 6 × 5 × 8 = 240.

**∴ The correct answer is 240.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 31, 61, and 91.

x is the greatest number that leaves the same remainder when dividing these numbers.

**Formula Used:**

If a number leaves the same remainder when dividing a, b, and c, then the greatest such number is the HCF of |a − b|, |b − c|, and |c − a|.

**Calculation:**

⇒ First difference = 61 − 31 = 30

⇒ Second difference = 91 − 61 = 30

⇒ Third difference = 91 − 31 = 60

⇒ x = HCF of 30, 30, and 60

⇒ x = 30

⇒ We need to find the LCM of x and 48, which is the LCM of 30 and 48.

⇒ Prime factorization of 30 = 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ Prime factorization of 48 = 2⁴ × 3

⇒ LCM(30, 48) = highest power of each prime factor present

⇒ LCM(30, 48) = 2⁴ × 3 × 5 = 16 × 15 = 240

**∴ The correct answer is 240.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Greatest Number Dividing with Same Remainder

When asked for the greatest number that divides a, b, and c leaving the same remainder, compute the HCF of their absolute differences: |a − b|, |b − c|, and |c − a|.

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The smallest positive integer that is exactly divisible by each of the given numbers. It is found by multiplying the highest power of all prime factors involved.

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

The largest positive integer that divides two or more numbers without leaving a remainder. It is the product of the lowest power of each common prime factor.
</p

questions.question: If the average marks of three sections of Class X, having 35, 40, and 25 students, respectively, are 90, 88, and 80, then the average marks of all the students of Class X, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of students = 35 : 40 : 25 = 7 : 8 : 5 (Total = 20 units)

Let assumed average = 80.

Net deviation = 7 × (90 − 80) + 8 × (88 − 80) + 5 × (80 − 80)

⇒ Net deviation = 70 + 64 + 0 = 134

⇒ Overall average = Assumed average + (Net deviation ÷ Total units) = 80 + (134 ÷ 20) = 86.7

**∴ The correct answer is 86.7 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students: n₁ = 35, n₂ = 40, n₃ = 25

Average marks: A₁ = 90, A₂ = 88, A₃ = 80

**Formula Used:**

Overall Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂ + n₃A₃) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + n₃)

 
 
 
 
 Avg: 90
 35 students
 
 Avg: 88
 40 students
 
 Avg: 80
 25 students

 

 Total Students = 100
 Overall Avg = ?

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total marks of first section = 35 × 90 = 3150

⇒ Total marks of second section = 40 × 88 = 3520

⇒ Total marks of third section = 25 × 80 = 2000

⇒ Total marks of all sections = 3150 + 3520 + 2000 = 8670

⇒ Total number of students = 35 + 40 + 25 = 100

⇒ Overall Average = 8670 ÷ 100 = 86.7

**∴ The correct answer is 86.7 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When combining multiple groups, the overall average is determined by taking the weighted mean of the averages of the individual groups using the formula: Aw = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂ + ... + nₖAₖ) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ... + nₖ).

Deviation Method (Assumed Mean)

This method simplifies calculations by choosing an assumed average and finding the net deviation. The actual average is calculated as: Actual Average = Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Total Count).
</p

questions.question: 400 custard apples were bought at ₹1200 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹900. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of custard apples.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price (CP) of 1 apple = 1200 ÷ 100 = ₹12

Profit per apple = 900 ÷ 400 = ₹2.25

Selling Price (SP) of 1 apple = 12 + 2.25 = ₹14.25

SP of 1 dozen (12 apples) = 14.25 × 12 = ₹171

**∴ The correct answer is ₹171.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total custard apples bought = 400

Cost Price (CP) per 100 apples = ₹1200

Total Profit on selling 400 apples = ₹900

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) + Profit

Value per dozen = (Total Value ÷ Total Quantity) × 12

 Calculation for 400 Custard Apples

Profit and Loss Percentage

Profit and loss are always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise. Formula: Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is offered on the Marked Price (MP) of an article. Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount. Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

Successive Discounts

When two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the effective single discount percentage is equal to (a + b − a × b ÷ 100)%.

questions.question: When x is subtracted from each of 55, 50, 23 and 22, the resulting numbers, in this order, are in proportion. What is the fourth proportion of 3, 7 and x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x is subtracted from a, b, c, d to make them proportional, then x = (ad − bc) ÷ ((a + d) − (b + c)).

Here a = 55, b = 50, c = 23, and d = 22.

x = (55 × 22 − 50 × 23) ÷ ((55 + 22) − (50 + 23)) = (1210 − 1150) ÷ (77 − 73) = 60 ÷ 4 = 15.

Fourth proportional of 3, 7, and 15 = (7 × 15) ÷ 3 = 105 ÷ 3 = 35.

**∴ The correct answer is 35.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given numbers: 55, 50, 23, and 22.

Let the subtracted number be x.

According to the given condition, the resulting numbers are in proportion:

⇒ (55 − x) : (50 − x) :: (23 − x) : (22 − x)

⇒ (55 − x) ÷ (50 − x) = (23 − x) ÷ (22 − x)

Cross multiplying the terms:

⇒ (55 − x)(22 − x) = (50 − x)(23 − x)

⇒ 1210 − 55x − 22x + x² = 1150 − 50x − 23x + x2

questions.question: If the height of a cylinder is 16 cm and radius is 14 cm, what is the curved surface area (in cm²) of it?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The formula for the curved surface area is 2 × π × r × h.

Since π = 22 ÷ 7 and the radius (14 cm) is perfectly divisible by 7, the 7 in the denominator cancels out.

Because the formula uses 22, the final result must be a multiple of 11.

Check the given options using the divisibility rule of 11 (difference of the sum of alternating digits):

Only 1408 satisfies this condition: (1 + 0) − (4 + 8) = −11, which is fully divisible by 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 1408 cm².**

questions.question: Find the fourth proportional of 4, 6 and 5.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any three numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional (d) can be found directly using the formula:

d = (b × c) ÷ a

Here, a = 4, b = 6, and c = 5.

Fourth proportional = (6 × 5) ÷ 4 = 30 ÷ 4 = 7.5

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 

 Product of Extremes (4 × x)
 
 
 

 Product of Means (6 × 5)

 
 
 4
 
 :

 
 6
 
 ::

 
 5
 
 :

 
 x

**Given:**

First term (a) = 4

Second term (b) = 6

Third term (c) = 5

**Formula Used:**

If four values a, b, c, and d are in proportion (a : b :: c : d), then the ratio of the first two equals the ratio of the last two.

⇒ a ÷ b = c ÷ d

⇒ Product of Extremes (a × d) = Product of Means (b × c)

**Calculations:**

Let the fourth proportional be x.

⇒ 4 : 6 :: 5 : x

⇒ 4 ÷ 6 = 5 ÷ x

⇒ 4 × x = 6 × 5

⇒ 4x = 30

⇒ x = 30 ÷ 4

⇒ x = 7.5

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is the square root of their product. It is given by x = √(a × b).

Third Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion such that a : b :: b : c, then c is called the third proportional, given by c = b² ÷ a.

Componendo and Dividendo Rule

If two ratios are equal such that a ÷ b = c ÷ d, then applying Componendo and Dividendo gives (a + b) ÷ (a − b) = (c + d) ÷ (c − d).
